title: Normal Chip H3K27ac Control
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Resuspend 1 × 10⁶ isolated cells and add formaldehyde to a final concentration of 1 % (v/v); incubate for 14 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Quench fixation with glycine
steps.instruction: Add glycine to the suspension to a final concentration of 125 mM; mix and incubate for 1 min to quench the cross‑linking.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS + inhibitors
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, catalog 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog 303410).

steps.title: Harvest cells by scraping
steps.instruction: Scrape the washed cells from the culture plates and collect the suspension.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei with Covaris
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to Covaris tubes and sonicate on the Covaris E220 instrument for 4.5 min at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 %, 200 cycles/burst to isolate nuclei.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate chromatin
steps.instruction: For each sample, add 2 µg of the specific antibody and protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, catalog 88802) to an equal amount of chromatin; incubate under the conditions described in Arrigoni 2018 (no barcode ligation or pooling).

steps.title: Quantify chromatin by Nanodrop
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the input chromatin using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Quantify IP DNA by Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure the amount of immunoprecipitated DNA with a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Construct libraries from the IP DNA using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England BioLabs, catalog E7645S) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate library size distribution and concentration with an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq platform using 150 bp paired‑end reads.
